pilotReasons: Eight discarded calls: Bash permissions not sufficiently bounded and warning-event retries; no golden/result access observed.

Thirty-one dispatched setup calls (29 complete, two interrupted): invalid absolute module keys. All current rows discarded; final brains use supported local module keys and pass actual CLI config validation.

Three tuning-edition calls discarded: current prompt incorrectly specified 2028 for a case whose intendedEdition is null. Corrected only that case to preserve the unknown edition; the candidate-only confidence calibration is unchanged.
One tuning monthly run had not read the shipped skill. Replaced after explicitly naming the installed SKILL.md path. All other accepted current runs read that same unmodified skill.
notes.normalization: Shared deterministic normalizer after source-span selection; arithmetic is not a separately measured native-agent output.
notes.reportParsing: The agent can preface a structured JSON field report with prose. Score that field object mechanically; do not penalize a parseable extraction as an invalid answer solely for prose.

findings.reason: The local date 2028-04-01 is unaffected by the CST ambiguity (US, China and Cuba all give the same date). Only the instant is unresolved. Gold sets the whole value to null, but other cases use {date, instant:null} when only the instant is unknown.
findings.suggestion: Document the policy. Either keep value null when a zone is missing, or use {date:'2028-04-01', instant:null} and make the same choice for held-wall-clock.

findings.reason: The source says 'not disclosed'. That means not announced, which is 'unclear' under the stated definition. It does not mean the thing is explicitly absent. Compare tune-instruction and tune-absent, where the unannounced items are 'unclear'.
findings.suggestion: Use unclear for salary, apply_url and contact_email, or state that an explicit 'not disclosed' maps to none.

findings.reason: 'No stated recruitment contact' means not announced, so it should be unclear. The wording is weaker than held-footer's 'has no recruitment contact'.
findings.suggestion: Use unclear, or make the none/unclear rule consistent across cases.

findings.reason: The date 2028-07-01 is clear. Only the instant is missing because there is no zone. Gold nulls the whole value, which conflicts with {date, instant:null} used elsewhere.
findings.suggestion: Document the policy for wall-clock times with no zone, or use {date:'2028-07-01', instant:null}.

findings.reason: 2026-07-12 is a Sunday. 'Next Saturday' could mean July 18 or July 25, so the rationale's July 18 is only one reading. 'Accepts outlines next Saturday' may also describe a single acceptance day, not a closing deadline. The notice date of 2026 also conflicts with intendedEdition 2028.
findings.suggestion: Make the weekday convention explicit (the nearest upcoming Saturday is July 18). Otherwise mark deadline unclear, or drop this case.

findings.reason: Annualizing hourly pay needs an assumed hours-per-year figure. The gold value uses 2080 (60.50×2080=125840; 70.25×2080=146120), and neither the source nor the context states it. The monthly case (tune-monthly) is not annualized, so the policy is inconsistent.
findings.suggestion: Specify the 2080-hour convention in the task or context. Otherwise keep hourly as {period:'hour', minMinor:6050, maxMinor:7025}, like the monthly case.

findings.reason: 'Pay is not disclosed' means not announced, so it should be unclear under the stated definition. The contact_email 'none' is correct because the source says there is no recruitment contact.
findings.suggestion: Set salary to unclear, or define 'not disclosed' as none consistently.

findings.reason: The source says 'address 45 minutes', not 'talk'. Treating an address as the talk slot is a reasonable reading, but the wording differs from other cases.
findings.suggestion: Optional: change the source wording to 'talk' or 'talk slot'.

findings.reason: 'No announced event dates' means not announced, which is 'unclear' by the stated definition. The case also conflicts with tune-absent and tune-instruction, which label similar unannounced items unclear.
findings.suggestion: Set event_start to role unclear, status unresolved.
Set event_end to role unclear, status unresolved.

resolutions.held-no-event: Corrected event_start/end to unclear: no announced dates is uncertainty, not absence of the event.
resolutions.held-hourly: Corrected unsupported annualization; preserve source hourly period and bounds.
resolutions.held-relative: Dropped: acceptance-day versus cutoff and next-week ambiguity, plus mismatched edition.
resolutions.none-policy: Explicit absence, not disclosed, and no stated contact all map to none. Missing mentions or ambiguous data map to unclear.
resolutions.date-policy: This spike scores semantic source spans. Legacy parser nulls for incomplete instants do not deny a stated role. Arithmetic is outside scope; no timezone invented.
resolutions.held-long: Address is a speaking slot; retained.

calibration.criterion: maximum exact role/occurrence accuracy on tuning; tie picks lowest floor

isolation.mechanism: Claude restricted file tools confined to disposable brain; exact-command PreToolUse hook plus allowedTools; separate runtime, no brain symlinks
